name: Escitalopram
summary: A common SSRI choice when tolerability and straightforward dosing are the priority.
good: When a clean, familiar SSRI option is needed.
bad: Significant QT concerns or high serotonergic polypharmacy.
clinicalPearls: Often favored for simplicity, but it is still an SSRI with the full class caveat set.
indications: Depression and generalized anxiety disorder, with off-label use in some anxiety-spectrum conditions.
interactionNotes: Other serotonergic drugs and QT-prolonging agents need review.

warnings: Sexual dysfunction, GI upset, hyponatremia, and QT prolongation at higher exposures.
